purpose: test whether a recent expressive asymmetric gated multimodal fusion control explains any EQIR gain without evidence-qualified exact fallback or dual-query base-relative tail-risk constraints

why_not_use_the_published_or_released_ad.headline: published results use warm random pair splits rather than BioMaster scaffold, homology, double, temporal or old-drug cold protocols
why_not_use_the_published_or_released_ad.reproducibility: exact random split files, seeds for five stated repeats, embeddings, weights and dependency environment are absent; model/dti.py imports a missing Fusion1.py
why_not_use_the_published_or_released_ad.data: Human and C. elegans releases contain 731 and 1234 repeated positive rows; released valid/test cold files contain repeated pairs
why_not_use_the_published_or_released_ad.implementation: released positional encoding operates on batch slot rather than token position and is not batch-permutation equivariant
why_not_use_the_published_or_released_ad.conclusion: the comparator below tests the paper-level asymmetric-gating hypothesis using corrected, capacity-matched semantics; it is not an official AD-LSF reproduction

shared_protocol.inner_validation: same deterministic grouped inner folds jointly respecting target homology and drug scaffold groups as EQIR
shared_protocol.fit_boundary: all projections, gates, fusion weights, normalization and checkpoints are learned within the current frozen TRAIN/VALID boundary; held TEST is evaluated once
shared_protocol.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of inner-validation micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC
selection_constraints: drug-macro must not be below the frozen query-balanced base
target-macro may be at most 0.002 below the frozen query-balanced base
held TEST labels may not influence preprocessing, model selection or calibration

frozen_inputs.missingness: zero structure vector plus explicit eligibility bit when a(t)=0

required_variants.name: ADLSF_INSPIRED_ASYMMETRIC_GATED_FUSION
required_variants.mechanism: project frozen drug, target, nonstructural-score and structure views separately; condition independent sigmoid gates for each view on the other three projected summaries; concatenate gated views, pairwise products, absolute differences, base logit and eligibility bit into a two-layer SiLU head
required_variants.objective: ordinary binary cross entropy without exact fallback, residual-only restriction or query-regret constraints

required_variants.name: ADLSF_INSPIRED_BIDIRECTIONAL_ALIGNMENT_FUSION
required_variants.role: tests whether explicit bidirectional view alignment explains any EQIR gain
required_variants.mechanism: the asymmetric gated control plus drug-to-target and target-to-drug projected alignment scores and nonstructural-to-structure and structure-to-nonstructural gates; no batch-position encoding or external data
required_variants.objective: ordinary binary cross entropy plus symmetric cosine-alignment regularization selected from a frozen grid

required_variants.name: EQIR_FULL
required_variants.role: preregistered qualified-structure adapter with exact fallback and dual-query base-relative upper-tail regret constraints

corrected_semantics.positional_encoding: none is used because every released input is a pooled frozen vector; the official batch-axis bug is not reproduced
corrected_semantics.dynamic_frequency_claim: not implemented for pooled vectors and not claimed as an official paper reproduction
corrected_semantics.normalization: LayerNorm or training-boundary StandardScaler only; no full-dataset fit
corrected_semantics.duplicates: BioMaster frozen pairs and folds remain authoritative; no AD-LSF released labels or duplicates enter training

capacity_and_training_fairness.parameter_matching: select the smallest control within plus or minus 10 percent of EQIR active trainable parameters; otherwise report the closest mismatch
capacity_and_training_fairness.same_batches: same fold-specific pair population, eligibility mask and seed order as EQIR

mandatory_metrics_and_gates.minimum_support: at least 4 of 5 EQIR seeds improve versus each control, both cold-axis CI lower bounds exceed zero, target-macro is noninferior within -0.002, drug-macro grouped CI lower bound exceeds zero and both query-direction permutation gates pass
